items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Jack Cary. Why don't you tell me about him too? Robichaud. He was good huh? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah he was good huh? Yeah he was here for a reserve somewhere up there. He died up there.

ctx.x: Had a fella named, we call him Diage. His name was Robichaud. He was a soft clarinet player but he could play. Who did he play with?
Jack Cary. Why don't you tell me about him too? Robichaud. He was good huh?
Yeah he was good huh? Yeah he was here for a reserve somewhere up there. He died up there.
